name: Shenzhen SOFARSOLAR Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen SOFARSOLAR Co., Ltd. provides solar photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage equipment for residential, commercial, industrial, and real estate industries in China and internationally. The company offers PV inverters, photovoltaic energy storage inverters, energy storage batteries, and photovoltaic system accessories; hybrid inverters; microinverters; residential PV inverters, energy storage systems (ESS), and storage inverters, as well as batteries; commercial and industrial inverters and ESS, PCS modules, and battery and energy storage cabinets; utility PV inverters and ESS, BESS, and smart string PCS; and AC EV chargers.
